blocks.zh: Section 4: Multivariate Procedures, RTRT & Submission｜多變量分析、RTRT與申報框架
blocks.en: Section 4: Multivariate Procedures, RTRT & Submission

blocks.zh: §8 多變量分析方法的開發
blocks.en: §8 Development of Multivariate Analytical Procedures

blocks.zh: 多變量分析方法的本質
blocks.en: What a Multivariate Procedure Is

blocks.zh: 多變量分析方法：通過使用多於一個輸入變量的校正模型來確定結果的分析方法。
blocks.en: Multivariate analytical procedure: an analytical procedure that determines a result by using a calibration model with more than one input variable.

blocks.zh: 典型範例：NIR（近紅外）光譜分析、拉曼光譜分析、多波長 UV 分析
blocks.en: Typical examples: NIR (near-infrared) spectroscopy, Raman spectroscopy, multi-wavelength UV analysis

blocks.zh: 核心原理：測量多個頻率/波長的吸光度（多個輸入變量）→ 通過數學模型（PLS、PCR 等） → 預測目標品質屬性（輸出）
blocks.en: Core principle: measure absorbance at multiple frequencies/wavelengths (multiple input variables) → apply a mathematical model (PLS, PCR, etc.) → predict the target quality attribute (output)

blocks.zh: 樣品選擇策略：代表性的關鍵
blocks.en: Sample Selection Strategy: Representativeness Is the Key

blocks.zh: 多變量模型的性能上限由校正集（calibration set）的樣品多樣性決定。樣品選擇的三個層次：
blocks.en: The performance ceiling of a multivariate model is set by the diversity of samples in the calibration set. Sample selection works at three levels:

blocks.zh: 潛在變量數目（Latent Variables）：多但不過
blocks.en: Number of Latent Variables: Enough, but Not Too Many

blocks.zh: 潛在變量數目是多變量模型開發中最關鍵的決策之一：
blocks.en: The number of latent variables is one of the most critical decisions in multivariate model development:

blocks.zh: 太少：模型欠擬合（under-fitting），預測精度不足
blocks.en: Too few: the model under-fits, and prediction accuracy is insufficient

blocks.zh: 太多：模型過擬合（over-fitting），記住了噪音而非真實信號 → 穩健性下降，需更頻繁重新校正
blocks.en: Too many: the model over-fits, memorizing noise rather than true signal → robustness declines and more frequent recalibration is needed

blocks.zh: 最佳數目：在校正集和驗證集上均有良好預測性能的最小數目
blocks.en: Optimal number: the smallest number that gives good predictive performance on both the calibration set and the validation set

blocks.zh: Q14 要求提供最終選擇的潛在變量數目的合理性說明，並可使用軟體提供的診斷圖（如 cross-validation plots）支持。
blocks.en: Q14 expects a justification for the final number of latent variables selected, which may be supported by diagnostic plots provided by the software (such as cross-validation plots).

blocks.zh: 模型維護的觸發條件（事件驅動 + 定期）
blocks.en: Triggers for Model Maintenance (Event-Driven + Periodic)

blocks.zh: 模型性能確認需在以下時機進行：
blocks.en: Model performance should be confirmed in the following situations:

blocks.zh: 定期（periodic）：按預定頻率使用參考樣品比較模型預測值與已知值
blocks.en: Periodic: at a predefined frequency, compare model predictions with known values using reference samples

blocks.zh: 事件驅動（event-driven）
blocks.en: Event-driven

blocks.zh: 新的已知製程變異（如原料供應商更換）
blocks.en: A new known process variation (e.g., a change of raw material supplier)

blocks.zh: 意外製程事件
blocks.en: An unexpected process event

blocks.zh: 排定的儀器維護（可能影響光源、光路）
blocks.en: Scheduled instrument maintenance (which may affect the light source or optical path)

blocks.zh: 模型生命週期三階段（圖3）
blocks.en: Three Stages of the Model Lifecycle (Figure 3)

blocks.zh: ICH Q14 圖3 描述了多變量模型的生命週期：
blocks.en: ICH Q14 Figure 3 describes the lifecycle of a multivariate model:

blocks.zh: 模型建立：樣品選擇 → 數據採集 → 校正 → 內部測試 → 驗證（獨立數據）→ 維護計畫
blocks.en: Model development: sample selection → data collection → calibration → internal testing → validation (independent data) → maintenance plan

blocks.zh: 例行使用：每次量測使用異常值診斷 → 定期/事件驅動確認
blocks.en: Routine use: outlier diagnostics with every measurement → periodic/event-driven confirmation

blocks.zh: 模型維護：發現不可接受性能 → 模型重新評估 → 可能需要重新開發或修改維護計畫
blocks.en: Model maintenance: unacceptable performance detected → model re-evaluation → possible redevelopment or modification of the maintenance plan

blocks.zh: 這是一個迭代的生命週期循環，允許模型隨著更多製程知識的積累而持續優化。
blocks.en: This is an iterative lifecycle loop that allows the model to be continually improved as more process knowledge accumulates.

blocks.zh: §9 即時放行試驗（RTRT）分析方法的開發
blocks.en: §9 Development of Real-Time Release Testing (RTRT) Analytical Procedures

blocks.zh: RTRT 的核心定義
blocks.en: Core Definition of RTRT

blocks.zh: RTRT（Real Time Release Testing）（來自 ICH Q8）：
blocks.en: RTRT (Real Time Release Testing) (from ICH Q8):

blocks.zh: 基於製程數據（通常包括測量的物料屬性和製程控制的有效組合）來評估和確保中間製程和/或最終產品品質的能力。
blocks.en: The ability to evaluate and ensure the quality of in-process and/or final product based on process data, which typically include a valid combination of measured material attributes and process controls.

blocks.zh: 關鍵特點：
blocks.en: Key characteristics:

blocks.zh: RTRT 不是獨立的，必須與整個產品控制策略的所有元素協同工作
blocks.en: RTRT is not standalone; it must work together with all elements of the overall product control strategy

blocks.zh: RTRT 可應用於 DS（藥物物質）、中間體（intermediates）和 DP（藥品）
blocks.en: RTRT can be applied to DS (drug substance), intermediates, and DP (drug product)

blocks.zh: 必須對目標 CQAs 具有充分的專一性
blocks.en: It must have sufficient specificity for the target CQAs

blocks.zh: RTRT 的驗證要求
blocks.en: Validation Requirements for RTRT

blocks.zh: RTRT 分析方法必須依照 ICH Q2 進行驗證（與傳統方法相同的要求），並且需要額外證明：
blocks.en: An RTRT analytical procedure must be validated in accordance with ICH Q2 (the same requirements as for a conventional procedure), and additionally needs to demonstrate:

blocks.zh: 製程量測對目標品質屬性具有適當的專一性
blocks.en: The process measurement has appropriate specificity for the target quality attribute

blocks.zh: 量測點能代表整個被處理物料（不是局部取樣）
blocks.en: The measurement point is representative of the whole material being processed (not a localized sample)

blocks.zh: 樣品介面在整個製造週期保持一致，對製程和環境變化穩健
blocks.en: The sample interface remains consistent throughout the manufacturing run and is robust to process and environmental changes

blocks.zh: RTRT 需納入產品規格的要求
blocks.en: Including RTRT in the Product Specification

blocks.zh: 依 ICH Q6A/Q6B，RTRT 方法需納入產品規格，包含：
blocks.en: Per ICH Q6A/Q6B, an RTRT procedure must be included in the product specification, including:

blocks.zh: 分析方法的參考（reference to the analytical procedure）
blocks.en: A reference to the analytical procedure

blocks.zh: 相關的驗收標準
blocks.en: The associated acceptance criteria

blocks.zh: 定量結果的表達單位（必須與傳統試驗相同）
blocks.en: The units in which quantitative results are expressed (which must be the same as for the conventional test)

blocks.zh: 替代控制策略的要求：若申請資料包含 RTRT 的「已登記替代控制策略」（如 PAT 設備不可用時的傳統試驗），相關分析方法和適用情況也必須在規格中說明。
blocks.en: Requirement for an alternative control strategy: if the application includes a registered alternative control strategy for RTRT (such as a conventional test to be used when the PAT equipment is unavailable), the related analytical procedure and the circumstances in which it applies must also be described in the specification.

blocks.zh: RTRT 在 CM（連續製造）中的應用
blocks.en: RTRT in CM (Continuous Manufacturing)

blocks.zh: RTRT 在 CM 中特別重要（見 ICH Q13 §4.2）：
blocks.en: RTRT is especially important in CM (see ICH Q13 §4.2):

blocks.zh: CM 的連續物料流使傳統的批次終點測試難以應用
blocks.en: The continuous flow of material in CM makes conventional batch end-point testing difficult to apply

blocks.zh: NIR 等線上/在線方法可在製造過程中持續監控 CQAs（如含量均一性、水分）
blocks.en: In-line/on-line methods such as NIR can monitor CQAs (e.g., content uniformity, moisture) continuously during manufacturing

blocks.zh: RTRT 方法的開發和驗證需遵循 Q14 §8（多變量）+ §9（RTRT）的雙重要求
blocks.en: Development and validation of an RTRT procedure must meet the combined requirements of Q14 §8 (multivariate) and §9 (RTRT)

blocks.zh: 整合思考問題
blocks.en: Integrated Review Question

blocks.zh: 一個錠劑製造商想用壓片機進料框架的 NIR 方法取代傳統的成品含量均一性測試（content uniformity, CU）。此方法需滿足哪些開發和驗證要求？
blocks.en: A tablet manufacturer wants to replace the conventional finished-product content uniformity (CU) test with an NIR method on the tablet press feed frame. What development and validation requirements must this method meet?

blocks.zh: 解答
blocks.en: Answer

blocks.zh: 此 NIR 方法屬於「多變量分析方法用於 RTRT」，需滿足 §8 和 §9 的雙重要求：
blocks.en: This NIR method is a "multivariate analytical procedure used for RTRT," so it must satisfy the combined requirements of §8 and §9:

blocks.zh: 開發要求（§8 多變量）：
blocks.en: Development requirements (§8 multivariate):

blocks.zh: 樣品選擇：涵蓋商業規模製造的所有預期含量變異（90–110% label claim）
blocks.en: Sample selection: cover all expected content variation at commercial scale (90–110% label claim)

blocks.zh: 參考方法：使用驗證的 HPLC 含量方法確定校正樣品的真實值
blocks.en: Reference method: use a validated HPLC assay method to establish the true values of the calibration samples

blocks.zh: 模型開發：確定最佳潛在變量數目；定義波長範圍；建立維護計畫
blocks.en: Model development: determine the optimal number of latent variables; define the wavelength range; establish a maintenance plan

blocks.zh: RTRT 特殊要求（§9）：
blocks.en: Special RTRT requirements (§9):

blocks.zh: 量測點代表性：NIR 探頭需代表整個批次的物料，非只是局部
blocks.en: Representativeness of the measurement point: the NIR probe must represent the material of the whole batch, not just a localized portion

blocks.zh: 專一性驗證：方法需對含量（vs. 顏色、水分等干擾）具有充分選擇性
blocks.en: Specificity verification: the method must be sufficiently selective for content (vs. interferences such as color or moisture)

blocks.zh: 樣品介面穩健性：探頭在整個製造週期（包括長時間 CM 運行）保持一致
blocks.en: Robustness of the sample interface: the probe must remain consistent throughout the manufacturing run (including long CM runs)

blocks.zh: 納入規格：在 DP 規格中列出 NIR RTRT 方法和驗收標準（與傳統測試相同單位）
blocks.en: Inclusion in the specification: list the NIR RTRT method and acceptance criteria in the DP specification (in the same units as the conventional test)

blocks.zh: 備援策略：PAT 故障時的傳統終點測試方案需在規格中說明
blocks.en: Fallback strategy: the conventional end-point testing plan to be used if the PAT system fails must be described in the specification

blocks.zh: §10 分析方法相關資訊的申報
blocks.en: §10 Submission of Analytical Procedure Information

blocks.zh: 分析方法資訊的 CTD 位置總整理
blocks.en: Summary of Where Analytical Procedure Information Sits in the CTD

blocks.zh: ECs vs. 支持性資訊的區分義務
blocks.en: Obligation to Distinguish ECs from Supportive Information

blocks.zh: 若申請包含 ECs，必須在申請資料中明確區分 ECs 和支持性資訊（supportive information）。
blocks.en: If the application includes ECs, it must clearly distinguish the ECs from supportive information.

blocks.zh: 這對應 ICH Q12 的相同要求，確保審查員能清楚了解哪些條件是法規綁定的（ECs），哪些只是背景資訊。
blocks.en: This mirrors the same requirement in ICH Q12 and ensures reviewers can clearly see which conditions are regulatory-binding (ECs) and which are merely background information.

blocks.zh: 多變量模型驗證的特殊申報要求（§10.3）
blocks.en: Special Submission Requirements for Multivariate Model Validation (§10.3)

blocks.zh: 用於規格（包括 RTRT）的多變量模型的驗證描述，需包含五個額外元素：
blocks.en: The description of the validation of a multivariate model used for a specification (including RTRT) should include five additional elements:

blocks.zh: 獨立驗證集的描述：說明驗證集樣品的選擇策略和代表性
blocks.en: Description of the independent validation set: explain the selection strategy and representativeness of the validation set samples

blocks.zh: 模型驗證的性能標準：具體的性能標準（如 RMSEP、SEP）
blocks.en: Performance criteria for model validation: specific performance criteria (such as RMSEP, SEP)

blocks.zh: 模型驗證結果評估：實際驗證結果與性能標準的對照
blocks.en: Evaluation of model validation results: the actual validation results compared against the performance criteria

blocks.zh: 模型性能標準與規格限度的關係：解釋模型的預測精度如何支持規格判定
blocks.en: Relationship between model performance criteria and specification limits: explain how the prediction accuracy of the model supports specification decisions

blocks.zh: PQS 模型監控和維護要素的高層概述：異常值診斷方法；異常值發生時的處理程序
blocks.en: High-level overview of the PQS elements for model monitoring and maintenance: the outlier diagnostic method and the procedure to follow when outliers occur

blocks.zh: §11 詞彙精要：Q14 vs. Q2(R2) 的術語對照
blocks.en: §11 Glossary Essentials: Q14 vs. Q2(R2) Terminology

blocks.zh: Q14 新引入術語 vs. Q2(R2) 既有術語
blocks.en: Terms Newly Introduced in Q14 vs. Existing Q2(R2) Terms

blocks.zh: 重要術語區分：AP Attribute vs. Performance Characteristic
blocks.en: Key Distinction: AP Attribute vs. Performance Characteristic

blocks.zh:
AP Attribute（分析方法屬性）：技術特有（technology-specific）
例：HPLC 的「解析度 Rs」只有在色譜分析中才有意義。
blocks.en:
AP Attribute (analytical procedure attribute): technology-specific
Example: "resolution Rs" in HPLC is meaningful only in chromatographic analysis.

blocks.zh:
Performance Characteristic（性能特性）：技術無關（technology-independent）
例：「準確度（accuracy）」對 HPLC、NIR、GC 等所有方法都適用。
blocks.en:
Performance Characteristic: technology-independent
Example: "accuracy" applies to all procedures, including HPLC, NIR, and GC.

blocks.zh: → 這個區分讓 ATP 可以用技術無關的語言定義要求（性能特性），而 SST 用技術特有的指標（AP attributes）來驗證在具體技術上的達成情況。
blocks.en: → This distinction lets the ATP define requirements in technology-independent language (performance characteristics), while the SST uses technology-specific indicators (AP attributes) to verify that they are met on the specific technology.

blocks.zh: Q14 綜合總結問題
blocks.en: Q14 Comprehensive Review Question

blocks.zh: 一家公司採用 Enhanced approach 開發了一個 HPLC 有關物質分析方法，並建立了 PAR 和 MODR，提交了 ATP 和 ECs。上市後，因儀器升級需要更換 HPLC 系統（相同方法原理，新廠牌儀器）。請描述完整的變更管理路徑。
blocks.en: A company developed an HPLC related-substances procedure using the enhanced approach, established a PAR and MODR, and submitted the ATP and ECs. After approval, the HPLC system must be replaced because of an instrument upgrade (same method principle, new instrument brand). Describe the complete change management pathway.

blocks.zh: 1. 變更識別和風險評估：
blocks.en: 1. Change identification and risk assessment:

blocks.zh: 屬於「同一原理內的變更」（Table 2）
blocks.en: This is a "change within the same principle" (Table 2)

blocks.zh: 評估新儀器對原已批准的 PAR/MODR 的影響
blocks.en: Assess the impact of the new instrument on the previously approved PAR/MODR

blocks.zh: 評估已批准的 SST 是否仍能在新儀器上有效偵測性能問題
blocks.en: Assess whether the approved SST can still effectively detect performance problems on the new instrument

blocks.zh: 2. 確認申報類別（依原提交的 EC 申報類別）：
blocks.en: 2. Confirm the reporting category (based on the reporting category of the originally submitted EC):

blocks.zh: 若「儀器廠牌」不是 EC → 此變更不需法規溝通，在 PQS 管理
blocks.en: If "instrument brand" is not an EC → this change requires no regulatory communication and is managed within the PQS

blocks.zh: 若「儀器廠牌」是 EC → 依原定申報類別（可能為通知）
blocks.en: If "instrument brand" is an EC → follow the established reporting category (possibly a notification)

blocks.zh: 3. 橋接研究（依 Table 2，同一原理內的變更）：
blocks.en: 3. Bridging studies (per Table 2, change within the same principle):

blocks.zh: 驗證 SST 在新儀器上的性能（系統精密度等）
blocks.en: Verify SST performance on the new instrument (system precision, etc.)

blocks.zh: 比較分析（代表性樣品在新舊系統上的結果比較）
blocks.en: Comparative analysis (compare results for representative samples on the old and new systems)

blocks.zh: 確認原 PAR/MODR 在新儀器上仍然有效
blocks.en: Confirm that the original PAR/MODR remains valid on the new instrument

blocks.zh: 4. 記錄和後續：
blocks.en: 4. Documentation and follow-up:

blocks.zh: 在 PQS 記錄此變更（無論是否需要申報）
blocks.en: Record the change in the PQS (whether or not a submission is required)

blocks.zh: 更新分析方法描述，反映新儀器
blocks.en: Update the analytical procedure description to reflect the new instrument
